caption: KServe sits above a predictor like Triton — it doesn't replace it.

code:
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1
kind: InferenceService
metadata:
  name: fraud-classifier
spec:
  predictor:
    triton:
      storageUri: "gs://models/fraud-classifier/"
      runtimeVersion: "23.10-py3"
      resources:
        limits:
          nvidia.com/gpu: 1
caption: No Deployment, Service, Ingress, or HPA here — KServe generates all of it underneath.
